source_rule: Fixed v8 final, the same source as v9/v10; never use their fitted diagnostic checkpoints or pick an intermediate. Verify the original 90 plus additional 72 saved train episodes and all 59877 pre-action rows.

solve.method: One augmented float64 least-squares solve per original output layer, with all-train stratified numerical targets and a source-relative ridge penalty; cast back to the original float32 network.
solve.weighting: Each of the four nonempty groups has mass 1/4. Within each group, existing reach-positive and reach-nonpositive strata have equal mass, and rows within a stratum are uniform. Boundary selection is exactly the original v5 selection, including its starts; repeated rows intentionally receive several group contributions. No train row is removed.
solve.objective: For each critic: sum_i p_i*((A_i*(w-w0) - (y_i-A_i*w0))/target_rms)^2 + ridge_strength*||w-w0||^2/head_scale^2; target_rms=max(sqrt(sum_i p_i*y_i^2),target_rms_floor); head_scale=max(||w0||,head_norm_floor). Bias is included in w and penalized. Numerical labels are unchanged.
solve.rule: Actor and both critic bodies remain fixed. Two head solves total, no ridge/tolerance/weight/source sweeps or retry. Report the analytic objective-based correction bound, the actual float32 parameter displacement, each group's error/sign changes, all starts, and the unchanged full train gate. A weighted objective improvement alone is never acceptance.

acceptance: Use unchanged original v5 full 90+72 episode train_gate before and after. Keep original and added trajectory errors separate and report old primary feasible recognition, all-start and original selected boundary signs. Also report the unchanged v9 25-start checks for continuity, without optimizing solely on those points. Scientific NAV-065/G4 remains unpassed in this pilot, even if its train gate passes.
failure_policy: Any real candidate solve is model fitting and requires a separately approved, hash-pinned registration. Exclusive new output, preserve attempts, partial checkpoints and failures, no continuation/transfer/restart. No development, extra candidate, architecture/body change or deployment in this proposal.
downstream: One diagnostic checkpoint and full-train impact review. If successful, review a separate extension to other candidates before any development/G4/budget-search work. Failure is evidence about this fixed-feature and fixed-regularization attempt, not proof that the architecture or RC-PPO cannot work.
